sloka: पङ्किभेदेन पुष्टाङ्गं समाश्रितसरोवरम् ।तिष्ठन्तं परया लक्ष्म्या तस्मिंस्तोयाशये नृप ।। ७.७७.९ ॥
transliteration: paṅkibhedena puṣṭāṅgaṁ samāśritasarovaram ।tiṣṭhantaṁ parayā lakṣmyā tasmiṁstoyāśaye nṛpa ।। 7.77.9 ॥

translations.english: O King, it was resting in that body of water, its limbs nourished by the rich environment, remaining there with supreme splendor.
